repo.name: acme.sh
repo.description: A pure Unix shell script ACME client for SSL / TLS certificate automation

readme.summary: The README has an excellent features overview and broad OS compatibility table, but the provided excerpt contains no installation commands, usage examples, or troubleshooting guidance.
readme.top_issue: The README content provided is truncated and contains no installation instructions, quick-start commands, or usage examples — only a feature list, badges, and OS support table.

injection_risks.description: The _dns_googledomains_api function uses curl to make HTTP requests with user-provided data. Although the data is JSON-encoded, it's still possible for an attacker to inject malicious data if they can manipulate the $GOOGLEDOMAINS_ACCESS_TOKEN or $txtvalue variables.

The _kappernet_api function uses curl to make HTTP requests with user-provided data. The $data variable is constructed using string concatenation, which makes it vulnerable to injection attacks if an attacker can manipulate the $fullhostname or $txtvalue variables.

The _kappernet_api function uses curl to make HTTP requests with user-provided data. The $url variable is constructed using string concatenation, which makes it vulnerable to injection attacks if an attacker can manipulate the $KAPPERNETDNS_Api or $param variables.
